text:
rachel: PR #3552 (retries + backoff section in API guide) is blocked. Reviewer wants explicit wording for server "retry-after" vs SDK backoff, and whether 409/duplicate-detection is ever returned by the runtime. Also docs-preview failed with a metadata 403. Tagging @owen and @ben for runtime/SDK confirmation.

owen: Link?

rachel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3552. The draft text says "server may return 429/5xx and clients should retry with backoff" but reviewer asked: do we ever return 409 for duplicate idempotent requests? And how should SDK backoff interact with server Retry-After?

ci-bot: docs-preview job #628 failed: error fetching runtime metadata (403). Logs: /builds/3552/logs/628.

ben: SDK quick note: JS SDK honors server Retry-After when present (it pauses retries the recommended seconds). For exponential backoff we add jitter on top. By default JS retries up to 3 attempts for idempotent ops, Python defaults to 1. SDKs will not retry non-idempotent calls unless the user enables a retry mode. We do auto-insert `x-idempotency-key` for retries unless user provides `idempotencyKey`.

owen: Runtime: we don't return 409 for duplicate detection. Instead, we rely on idempotency key behavior: if a request with the same x-idempotency-key and identical payload is received while the first is still in-flight, we will return the same request outcome when possible, but we do not return a separate 409. Server responses for heavy load are 429 or 5xx. We do include `Retry-After` header on 429 when we can compute a delay window (best-effort).

rachel: Good — so doc text should say: "Runtime will not return 409 for duplicates; use x-idempotency-key to ensure safe retries. On 429 the runtime may include Retry-After; SDKs will honor it and apply client backoff/jitter." Also we need to fix preview 403.

ben: For the preview issue: docs-preview SA still lacks the `runtime-reader` role for the metadata endpoint. Two fixes: add role to SA (ops change) or replace live metadata call in the public snippet with a preview stub. For speed, do the stub and ask ops to update SA.

rachel: Plan: 1) update PR to include the explicit sentences above, 2) change the live metadata call in the quickstart snippet to `const meta = { env: 'PREVIEW_STUB' } // preview-only` so linkcheck/preview doesn't hit runtime, 3) push and retrigger preview, 4) ask @owen to confirm runtime wording in the PR thread, 5) merge in tomorrow's window.

owen: Confirmed: wording is accurate. No 409 behavior. Approve for runtime.

ci-bot: retriggered docs-preview #628 (attempt 2).

ci-bot: docs-preview #628 succeeded.

rachel: Thanks all — requested reviewer re-approval and will merge in the scheduled window once approvals are back. Leaving a follow-up to add a short FAQ on SDK honor of Retry-After vs client backoff. :white_check_mark:
